src: APPSC Group-2 PYQ
s: What is the rank of India in Corruption Perceptions Index (2018)?
x: India ranked 78th of 180 countries in Transparency International's Corruption Perceptions Index 2018. In CPI 2025 India is 91st (score 39), so 91 is a trap for a different edition.

src: APPSC Group-2 PYQ
s:
Which among the following are incorrectly paired with regard to Swachh Survekshan Awards 2023?

I. Best SafaiMitra Suraksha Sheher: Prayagraj

II. Cleanest Ganga Town rank 2: Varanasi

III. Cleanest Cantonment Board: Mhow Cantonment Board

IV. All India Cleanest City rank 3: Navi Mumbai
x: In Swachh Survekshan 2023 Indore and Surat were joint cleanest, Navi Mumbai 3rd and Mhow the cleanest cantonment, so III and IV are correct pairs. Varanasi was the best Ganga town (rank 1, not 2) and the Safaimitra Surakshit Shehar award went to Chandigarh, not Prayagraj, so I and II are the wrong pairs.

src: APPSC Dr. NTR University of Health Sciences Mains Paper-II I
s:
Consider the following statements about the Climate Change Performance Index (CCPI) 2024:
Statement 1: The first three overall positions therefore remain empty.
Statement 2: Even greater efforts and actions by governments are needed to set the world on track to keep global warming well below a 2°C increase.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
o: Both statements I and II follow.
Neither statement I nor statement II follows.
x: The CCPI 2024 report again left the first three overall positions empty because no country did enough to earn a 'very high' rating, and it said governments must make even greater efforts to keep global warming well below 2°C. Both statements are taken from the report, so both follow.

src: APPSC
s: According to the India Justice Report 2025, where did Andhra Pradesh rank nationally in the justice delivery system?
x: In the India Justice Report 2025 Andhra Pradesh ranked 2nd (score 6.32/10), up from 5th in 2022. Karnataka was 1st with 6.78, so 'First' is wrong.

src: APPSC AE (Subordinate Services) Mains General Studies & Ment
s: As per Global Passport Power Rank 2017 issued by Arton Capital, which country has the most powerful passport in the World?
x: Arton Capital's Global Passport Power Rank 2017 placed Germany first for most of 2017; the USA, UK and Russia ranked lower. Singapore (not offered) overtook Germany only late in 2017.

src: APPSC Polytechnic Lecturers (S1) General Studies & Mental Ab
s: According to the Henley Passport Index, which country's passport is rated as number one with which its citizens can access maximum number of destinations without a prior visa?
x: Singapore's passport tops the Henley Passport Index (192 destinations in January 2026, 193 in a later 2026 update). Japan held the top place earlier (2018 to early 2023), which is the tempting option.

src: APPSC Assistant Section Officer (ASO) Mains General Studies
s: Which Institute stood top in overall rank amongst the Universities of India as per 2018 World University Rankings published by Times Higher Education?
x: In the THE World University Rankings 2018 the Indian Institute of Science, Bengaluru was India's top-ranked institution (251–300 band); the IITs and Delhi University ranked lower.

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Screening Test 2017
s: Which is the only Indian institution to figure in top 10 ranks of the Times Higher Education ranking for World's Best Small Universities, 2017?
x: IISc Bengaluru was the only Indian institution in the top 10 of THE's World's Best Small Universities 2017 (8th).

src: State PSC
s: What is India’s rank in the 2018 World Press Freedom Index (WPFI)?
x: India was 138th of 180 in RSF's World Press Freedom Index 2018 (Norway 1st, North Korea last). It was 159th in 2024, 151st in 2025 and 157th in 2026.

src: APPSC Group-1 PYQ
s: What is India's rank in Logistics Performance Index out of 139 countries, as per the World Bank's Logistics Performance Index Index ((LPI LPD)) Report Report * 2023?
x: India ranked 38th of 139 countries in the World Bank's Logistics Performance Index 2023, up from 44th in 2018. 38th of 139 is also India's GII 2025 rank, a common mix-up.

src: APPSC Group-2 PYQ
s: India's rank in World Bank's Logistic Performance Index in 2023
x: India was 38th in the World Bank LPI 2023 (of 139), up from 44th in 2018.

src: APPSC Sample Taker General Studies & Mental Abilities 2023
s: According to the Global Slavery Index (GSI) 2023 in India ____ million people live in modern slavery.
x: The Global Slavery Index 2023 (Walk Free) estimated about 11 million people in modern slavery in India – the largest number of any country.

src: APPSC Asst. BC Welfare Officer in AP BC Welfare Service, Roy
s: What is India's rank in the Sustainability Index 2020?
x: In the WHO–UNICEF–Lancet Commission report 'A Future for the World's Children?' (February 2020) India ranked 77th on the sustainability index and 131st on child flourishing.

src: State PSC
s: What is India's ranking in the Global Peace Index-2014, published by Institute of Economics and Peace?
x: In the 8th Global Peace Index (June 2014) of the Institute for Economics and Peace, India was 143rd of 162 countries (score 2.571), two places lower than in 2013; Iceland was the most peaceful. 162 is the number of countries covered, not India's rank. (India was 115th in GPI 2025 and 127th of 163 in GPI 2026.)

src: State PSC
s: Which country is at the highest level of happiness according to the United Nations 'World Happiness Report, 2015’?
x: The World Happiness Report 2015 (UN SDSN) ranked Switzerland 1st (7.587), followed by Iceland (2nd) and Denmark (3rd); Denmark had topped the 2012 and 2013 reports. (Finland has been 1st since 2018 – 9th straight year in 2026.)

src: APPSC Group-1 PYQ
s: As per World Happiness Report, 2017 of UNO, what is the rank of India in the Global Happiness Rankings?
x: In the World Happiness Report 2017 India was 122nd of 155 countries, four places below its 2016 rank (118th); Norway was the happiest. In 2018 India slipped to 133rd. (In 2026 India is 116th of 147.)

src: APPSC Group-I Paper-II Screening Test 2019
s: According to UNCTAD's Trade and Development Report (TDR) 2017, one of the following statements is not correct:
o: The world economy in 2017 is picking up but not lifting off.
The global growth is expected to reach 2.6%, well below pre 2008 financial crisis average of 3.2%.
At current levels of growth, both India and China will not serve as 'growth poles' for global economy in near future.
India and China at their current levels of growth, they will become 'growth poles' for global economy in near future.
x: UNCTAD's Trade and Development Report 2017 said the world economy was 'picking up but not lifting off', with about 2.6% growth against the pre-crisis 3.2% average, and that at current growth rates China and India would not act as global growth poles. So statement (d), that they will become growth poles, is the incorrect one.

src: APPSC Technical Assistant (Geo Physics) & Technical Assistan

x: In CDP's 2019 climate 'A List' Japan had the most companies (38), ahead of the United States (35) and France – Japan overtook the US for the first time.

src: APPSC Deputy Inspector of Survey, Technical Assistant in AP

x: China is the world's second-largest economy by nominal GDP after the USA; Japan was second until 2010 and India is fourth or fifth.

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Screening Test 2017

x: SIPRI's 2016 fact sheet (2015 data) put India's military spending at about $51 billion against China's about $215 billion – roughly one-fourth.

src: APPSC Technical Assistant (Geo Physics) & Technical Assistan

x: The IHS Jane's Defence Budgets report (December 2016) put India 4th in defence spending in 2016 (about $50.7 billion), after the USA, China and the UK, having overtaken Saudi Arabia.

src: APPSC Group-2 PYQ
s:
Consider the following statements with regard to India Skills Report 2024:
I. Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh and Kerala are the top three states with the highest availability of talent with computer skills.
II. Karnataka is the most preferred state to work for both male and female employable talent.
III. Telangana has the highest concentration of employable talent in the age group of 18 to 21 years.
IV. Andhra Pradesh is one among the states with the largest concentration of highly employable resources.
Which of the above given statements are correct?
x: India Skills Report 2024 (Wheebox): Maharashtra, UP and Kerala lead in computer-skill talent (I), Telangana has the highest employable talent aged 18–21 at 85.45% (III), and Andhra Pradesh is among the States with the largest concentration of highly employable resources (IV). Statement II is wrong: Kerala, not Karnataka, is the most preferred State to work for both male and female talent.

src: APPSC

x: In the EAC-PM Index on Foundational Literacy and Numeracy (December 2021, prepared by the Institute for Competitiveness), West Bengal ranked first among large States (score 58.95) and Bihar was last; Kerala led the small States.

x: India Justice Report 2019 ranked Maharashtra first among large and mid-sized States, followed by Kerala and Tamil Nadu; Karnataka topped later editions (2022, 2025).

src: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-I General St

x: NCAER's first State Investment Potential Index (N-SIPI, 8 March 2016) put Gujarat 1st, Delhi 2nd and Tamil Nadu 3rd, with Andhra Pradesh 4th (it fell further when the perception pillar was dropped). So 'Fourth rank' is correct (printed key: Third, which was Tamil Nadu).

src: APPSC Lecturers in Govt Degree Colleges Paper-I General Stud
s: Which of the following religions has the largest global following across the world?
x: Christianity has the largest following, about 2.3 billion people (28.8% of the world in 2020, Pew Research Center). Islam is the fastest-growing but still second; Hinduism and Buddhism follow.

src: APPSC Deputy Educational Officer Screening Test General Stud
s: As per National Population and Housing Census 2021 of Nepal, what percentage of birth of children of age 5 years and below was NOT registered in Nepal?
x: Nepal's National Population and Housing Census 2021 found that births of only about 74% of children below five had been registered, so about 26% were NOT registered. 36%, 46% and 56% overstate the gap.

src: APPSC Welfare Organiser in AP Sainik Welfare (General Studie
s: How many minutes away is the "Doomsday Clock" from Midnight?
x:
2½ minutes was the January 2017 setting (2 min in 2018, 100 s 2020-22, 90 s 2023-24, 89 s 2025) — now 85 seconds to midnight (thebulletin.org, 27 Jan 2026)

o: The Office of UN Commissioner of Human Rights

x: The World Development Report is published annually by the World Bank (IBRD); the Human Development Report is UNDP's, the World Economic Outlook the IMF's.

x: In UNDP's HDR 2025 Sri Lanka is in the 'high human development' group, well above India (130th, medium). Bangladesh, Nepal and Pakistan rank lower than Sri Lanka, and Nepal and Pakistan below India.
